source.text: The Information : Google will require that AI agents use MCP servers, not the REST API, to access Workspace apps starting in February, drawing developer backlash — Two days before Thanksgiving, Google unveiled new controls on how AI assistants access Gmail and other Google-run productivity applications.

draft.headline: Google will require AI agents to use MCP servers instead of REST APIs to access Workspace apps starting in February.
draft.threads_post:
Starting in February, Google will require AI agents to use MCP servers instead of REST APIs to access Workspace apps.

The update affects AI assistant access to Gmail and other Google productivity applications. Google unveiled the rule two days before Thanksgiving, and the decision is already drawing developer backlash.

Good move for agent control, or unnecessary friction for developers?
